# Fastfetch

![preview](https://github.com/fastfetch-cli/fastfetch/raw/dev/screenshots/example1.png)

Fastfetch is a neofetch-like tool for fetching system information and displaying it prettily.

## Features

Fast, highly customisable, and it shows your system beside a logo.

## Customization

Drop a GIF at `~/Pictures/gif/skel.gif` and it plays as the logo.

## Building

cmake and a C compiler.
